name: Abe no Nakamaro
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 7); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. 780.

poems.title: While gazing up into the sky
poems.author: Abe no Nakamaro
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 7
poems.text:
While gazing up into the sky,
My thoughts have wandered far;
Methinks I see the rising moon
Above Mount Mikasa
At far-off Kasuga.

poems.title: 7. 天の原 ふりさけ見れば 春日なる (Ama no hara furisakemireba Kasuga naru)
poems.author: Abe no Nakamaro
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 古今集
poems.text:
天の原 ふりさけ見れば 春日なる
みかさの山に 出でし月かも
